turns.user: a 10 second clip of a man walking home at night, in the style of Wong Kar-wai
turns.message:
Wong Kar-wai’s style is built on step-printed motion blur, emerald greens, and the glow of neon in the rain. Before I carry this idea across, do you have a photo of the man or the street I should use? 

If not, I can draft the scene now, but it will need a reference photo before the studio can render it.
turns.brief:
SUBJECT: A man walking home.
SETTING: A narrow, urban street at night, slick with rain and lit by flickering neon.
ACTION: He walks with a heavy, rhythmic pace, lost in thought.
STYLE: Wong Kar-wai. Saturated jewel tones (emerald, amber), heavy motion blur, and wide-angle lenses close to the subject.
PACING: Lingering and rhythmic, using slow motion to stretch the walk.
SOUND: Distant city hum, muffled footsteps on wet pavement, a melancholic cello theme.
LENGTH: 10 seconds.

turns.message: A 10-second scene of a solitary man walking home at night, in the style of Wong Kar-wai. PALETTE: Emerald greens, warm ambers, and bruised reds. LIGHT: Low-key, neon practicals, fluorescent glow, high contrast. LENS: Wide-angle, heavy film grain, soft hazy finish. MOVEMENT: Step-printed motion blur, handheld rhythmic follow. SETTING: Rain-slicked alleyway, cramped urban textures. (0-4s) Medium follow shot from behind. A man in a dark trench coat walks through a narrow alley. Emerald neon light catches the rain. (4-7s) Low angle close-up on polished shoes splashing through golden-lit puddles. (7-10s) Wide profile shot. The man passes under a flickering red neon sign, his face obscured by shadow as he turns a corner. SOUND: Muffled city rain, the hum of neon, distant rhythmic footsteps on wet pavement.
